# Goodera

> Goodera is a corporate volunteering platform that enables scalable, meaningful employee engagement through 50+ vetted volunteer opportunities across virtual, in-person, and hybrid work environments.

Goodera partners with major enterprises like Citrix, Kyndryl, and PayPal to deliver CSR programs, ERG engagement, and team-building activities that drive social impact while strengthening workplace culture. The platform offers year-round campaigns, cause-specific volunteering, and customized solutions for distributed and in-office teams.

## Key Topics
